ideas.title: Blink Loyalty Beacon
ideas.elevator_pitch: NFC-enabled Blinks that let local businesses reward customers with instant token redemption just by tapping their Seeker phone at checkout.
ideas.description: Physical NFC beacons in restaurants, cafes, and shops that generate dynamic Blinks for loyalty rewards. Customers tap their Seeker to instantly claim tokens, redeem discounts, or unlock tier benefits. Businesses configure reward rules via dashboard. Uses ZK compression to make micro-rewards cost-effective ($0.00001 per redemption). Token Extensions enable interest-bearing loyalty points and confidential VIP tiers.
ideas.target_users: Local business owners (cafes, restaurants, retail) with 50+ daily customers seeking affordable loyalty programs
ideas.competitive_advantage: Sub-cent transactions via ZK compression make micro-rewards profitable; Blinks enable instant social sharing of rewards; Seeker NFC eliminates app downloads
ideas.revenue_model: $29/month SaaS per business + $99 hardware beacon + 2% transaction fee on token redemptions
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1-2: Deploy token program with extensions. Week 3-4: Build NFC beacon prototype with dynamic Blink generation. Week 5-6: Create business dashboard for reward configuration. Week 7-8: Test with 3 local businesses. Week 9-10: Refine UX based on merchant feedback. Week 11-12: Launch MVP with pilot merchants.

ideas.seeker_features: NFC for beacon interaction, camera for QR backup, GPS for location verification

ideas.title: Social MEV Pools
ideas.elevator_pitch: Turn MEV extraction into a social game where friends pool funds and share profits from automated Solana arbitrage bots through Blinks-powered group wallets.
ideas.description: Users create or join MEV extraction groups (5-20 people) that pool capital for automated arbitrage strategies. Built on ZK compression for cheap group transactions and Blinks for instant profit distribution via social media. Members vote on strategy changes, see real-time P&L, and earn reputation scores. Unlike solo bots, social pressure creates accountability and shared learning, while pooled capital accesses better opportunities.
ideas.target_users: Crypto-native retail traders with $500-5000 capital who want MEV exposure but lack technical skills
ideas.competitive_advantage: Solana's speed enables real-time profit distribution; Blinks make group joining frictionless; ZK compression makes micro-distributions economical
ideas.revenue_model: 15% performance fee on group profits, premium analytics subscriptions at $29/month
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1-2: Build basic group wallet smart contract with profit distribution. Week 3-4: Implement Blinks integration for group joining. Week 5-8: Develop simple arbitrage strategies and Jito integration. Week 9-10: Build social features (voting, reputation). Week 11-12: Launch MVP with 3 pilot groups, iterate based on feedback.
ideas.seeker_features: NFC for in-person group creation, camera for QR code group invites, notifications for profit alerts

ideas.title: Meme Terminal Mobile
ideas.elevator_pitch: First mobile-native pump.fun terminal that uses Seeker's camera to scan QR codes at events and instantly surface token analytics, social sentiment, and one-tap trading through Blinks.
ideas.description: Mobile-first pump.fun analytics terminal leveraging Seeker's hardware. Scan QR codes at crypto events/meetups to instantly pull token data, holder analysis, and social metrics. Uses ZK compression for 5000x cheaper on-chain analytics storage. Integrates Blinks for one-tap trading without app switching. GPS tracks trending tokens by location. Camera scans token logos for instant recognition.
ideas.target_users: Crypto conference attendees, meme coin traders who want mobile-first analytics
ideas.competitive_advantage: Only mobile terminal leveraging Seeker hardware for physical-to-digital token discovery and ZK compression for cheap analytics storage
ideas.revenue_model: Premium analytics subscriptions ($20/month), trading fee sharing (0.1% of volume)
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1: Set up React Native with Solana Mobile SDK, implement basic camera QR scanning. Week 2: Integrate pump.fun API for token data, build analytics dashboard. Week 3: Implement Blinks for trading, add GPS location features. Week 4: Deploy ZK compression for analytics storage, beta test at local crypto meetup.

ideas.title: Prophet Blinks Oracle
ideas.elevator_pitch: ZK-compressed prediction market outcomes streamed through Blinks enable AI agents to make instant, verifiable bets with 1000x lower oracle costs than Chainlink.
ideas.description: Oracle infrastructure that compresses prediction market outcomes (elections, sports, crypto prices) using ZK compression and streams them via Blinks for instant consumption by AI trading agents. Unlike traditional oracles, this creates a two-way market where agents can both consume predictions and contribute outcome data for rewards. Solana's 150ms finality enables real-time arbitrage between prediction markets and spot markets.
ideas.target_users: AI agent developers building trading bots that need fast, cheap prediction market data feeds
ideas.competitive_advantage: ZK compression makes oracle data 1000x cheaper than Ethereum alternatives, Blinks enable instant agent consumption, Solana speed enables cross-market arbitrage
ideas.revenue_model: Oracle subscription fees (0.001 SOL per query) + marketplace commission (2% on agent rewards)
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1-2: Deploy basic ZK-compressed oracle contract. Week 3-4: Build Blinks integration for data streaming. Week 5-8: Create agent reward marketplace with token extensions. Week 9-12: Launch with 3 prediction market integrations and 10 AI agent partners.

colosseum_analysis.insight: MCP payment middleware for AI agents

ideas.title: Wallet Social Graph
ideas.elevator_pitch: Turn every Phantom transaction into social signals, creating wallet-based friend discovery and reputation scores that unlock exclusive token launches and community access.
ideas.description: Analyzes on-chain Phantom wallet interactions to build social graphs - who trades similar tokens, uses same dApps, or holds matching NFT collections. Creates reputation scores based on trading success, early adoption, and community engagement. Wallet holders can opt into social discovery, get matched with similar traders, and access token launches based on their social graph score. Uses ZK compression for privacy-preserving social data.
ideas.target_users: Active Phantom users trading memecoins and seeking alpha from successful wallets
ideas.competitive_advantage: Phantom's 7M+ users provide massive social graph data; ZK compression enables private social scoring at scale impossible on other chains
ideas.revenue_model: Premium subscriptions for advanced analytics, whitelisting fees for token launches
ideas.build_guideline: Week 1-2: Set up wallet tracking with Helius webhooks. Week 3-4: Build social graph algorithms. Week 5-8: Implement ZK compression for privacy. Week 9-10: Create reputation scoring system. Week 11-12: Build frontend and launch beta with 100 Phantom power users.
